description: Guided webhook onboarding: device sends HTTP POST. Agent must create the device with webhook adapter, give the webhook URL, and verify.

turns.user: My device can push data over HTTP. How do I connect it to NeoMind?
OK, set it up for me.

per_turn: Turn 1: Agent explains the webhook onboarding path (create device with webhook adapter + get webhook URL)
Turn 2: Agent creates device with --adapter-type webhook and retrieves the webhook URL via `neomind device webhook-url`
expectations.overall: Device created with webhook adapter AND webhook URL provided to user.
